body.name: Residual-forest-to-lock handle
body.construction: From the shared role graph, choose a deterministic maximal-intervention all-fail terminal state, extract Chen--Mooij's residual region and represented selected forest for that complete terminal intervention, parameterize a rational interior one-forest mechanism table, compute \(E_T\) and \(b_T\), and, only if the rank test fails, enlarge to a two-mechanism rational tangent space before testing again.
